archimate:Goal.name: Digitally strengthen public health surveillance and response systems, adverse event reporting, and maximize appropriate secondary use of data for public health purposes
archimate:Goal.documentation:
An overarching, comprehensive strategic goal focused on modernizing a nation's health infrastructure through interconnected digital tools, secure data governance, and automated reporting pathways.
Its primary purpose is to transform fragmented health data into a unified, proactive defense network that protects population health by drastically reducing outbreak response times, ensuring medical product safety, and driving evidence-based health policies.
Example: By integrating interoperability gateways, real-time alerting services, and anonymized research databases into a singular national framework, health authorities can instantly detect a localized pathogen spike, monitor any adverse reactions to the deployed treatments, and seamlessly share aggregated data with scientists to refine long-term preventative care.
